metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1952 · Limelight
metas.description: A fading comedian and a suicidally despondent ballet dancer must look to each other to find purpose and hope in their lives.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1925 · The Phantom of the Opera
metas.description: A mad, disfigured composer seeks love with a lovely young opera singer.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1957 · A Face in the Crowd
metas.description: Female radio reporter Marcia Jeffries turns folk-singing drifter Larry "Lonesome" Rhodes into a powerful media star who becomes utterly detestable during his meteoric rise.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1930 · The Blue Angel
metas.description: An elderly professor's ordered life spins dangerously out of control when he falls for a nightclub singer.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1967 · Bob Dylan: Dont Look Back
metas.description: Documentary covering Bob Dylan's 1965 tour of England, which includes appearances by Joan Baez and Donovan.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1947 · It Happened on Fifth Avenue
metas.description: Two homeless men move into a mansion while its owners are wintering in the South.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1958 · The Music Room
metas.description: Depicts the end days of a decadent zamindar (landlord) in Bengal, and his efforts to uphold his family prestige even when faced with economic adversity.
